zin_sp_reward_burned_hands = {
	narrative = {
		name = zin_sp_reward_burned_hands
		desc = zin_sp_reward_burned_hands_desc
	}
	icon = GFX_zin_sp_reward_burned_hands
	fire_only_once = yes
	threshold = { min = 0 max = 100 }
	weight = {
		base = 0.5
		modifier = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_inst_dark = global.zin_gathering_dark }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_inst_dark = 0.005 }
			add = zin_inst_dark
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.5
			var:scientist = { has_trait = zin_sch_steady_hand }
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.5
			var:scientist = { has_trait = zin_sch_cautious }
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 1.5
			var:scientist = { has_trait = zin_sch_restless }
		}
	}
	option = {
		token = zin_sp_reward_burned_hands_option
		narrative = {
			name = zin_sp_reward_burned_hands_option
		}
		iteration_output = {
			scientist_effects = {
				injure_scientist_for_days = 60
			}
			country_effects = {
				FROM = {
					add_project_progress_ratio = -0.05
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

zin_sp_reward_scarred_ground_war = {
	narrative = {
		name = zin_sp_reward_scarred_ground_war
		desc = zin_sp_reward_scarred_ground_war_desc
	}
	icon = GFX_zin_sp_reward_scarred_ground_war
	fire_only_once = yes
	threshold = { min = 0 max = 100 }
	weight = {
		base = 0.4
		modifier = {
			set_temp_variable = { zin_inst_dark = global.zin_gathering_dark }
			multiply_temp_variable = { zin_inst_dark = 0.004 }
			add = zin_inst_dark
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.5
			var:scientist = { has_trait = zin_sch_steady_hand }
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.5
			var:scientist = { has_trait = zin_sch_cautious }
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 1.5
			var:scientist = { has_trait = zin_sch_restless }
		}
		modifier = {
			factor = 0
			var:facility_state = { OR = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_hollow } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_wrecked } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_scorched } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_blighted } } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		token = zin_sp_reward_scarred_ground_war_option
		narrative = {
			name = zin_sp_reward_scarred_ground_war_option
		}
		iteration_output = {
			facility_state_effects = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { OR = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_hollow } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_wrecked } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_scorched } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_blighted } } }
					}
					add_dynamic_modifier = {
						modifier = zin_inst_scar_hollow
						days = 365
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

	}
	option = {
		token = zin_sp_reward_scarred_ground_sky_option
		narrative = {
			name = zin_sp_reward_scarred_ground_sky_option
		}
		iteration_output = {
			facility_state_effects = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = { OR = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_hollow } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_wrecked } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_scorched } has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_inst_scar_blighted } } }
					}
					add_dynamic_modifier = {
						modifier = zin_inst_scar_scorched
						days = 365
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
